name: spec-to-app-agent
description: Agent that turns a natural-language specification into a working React + TypeScript application.

scripts.graph:png: node --input-type=module -e "const { writeFile } = await import('node:fs/promises'); const { buildGraph } = await import('./agent/src/graph/index.ts'); const blob = await (await buildGraph().getGraphAsync()).drawMermaidPng(); await writeFile('docs/graph.png', Buffer.from(await blob.arrayBuffer())); console.log('docs/graph.png')"
